n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: William's asleep at last. Now it's time for us. Would you like a cup of tea, dear?

translations.fa: بالاخره ویلیام خوابید. حالا وقت ماست. یه فنجون چای میل داری عزیزم؟

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: No, no, sit down. You're my guest. How do you like your tea?

translations.fa: نه، نه، بشین. مهمون منی. چای را چطوری دوست داری؟

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Ooh, very Persian! Tom likes his tea "builder's" — very strong, two sugars.

translations.fa: اوه، خیلی ایرانی! تام چایش را «بنایی» دوست داره — خیلی پررنگ، دو تا قند.

branches.suggestion: In Iran, we drink tea with sugar cubes.
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران با قند چای می‌خوریم.

cultureNote.en: "Builder's tea" is strong black tea with milk and sugar — named after workers who drink lots of it.

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Strong tea for hard workers! Would you like a slice of Victoria sponge? I made it this morning.

translations.fa: چای پررنگ برای آدم‌های سخت‌کوش! یه برش کیک ویکتوریا میل داری؟ امروز صبح پختمش.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Just a small piece.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، لطفاً. فقط یه تیکهٔ کوچیک.

match: yes please a small one piece
recasts.echo: A small piece? Here you are.
recasts.better: Yes, please. Just a small piece.
recasts.betterFa: آره، لطفاً. فقط یه تیکهٔ کوچیک.

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Full? Nonsense! A small piece never hurt anybody. Here. With jam and cream.

translations.fa: سیر؟ مزخرفه! یه تیکهٔ کوچیک به کسی آسیب نزده. بیا. با مربا و خامه.

branches.suggestion: This is the best cake ever.

cultureNote.en: British hosts often insist on cake — a polite "Just a small piece, then" usually works best!

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Oh, you're a charmer! Would you like more tea? There's plenty in the pot.

translations.fa: آه، چه زبون‌بازی! چای بیشتر میل داری؟ تو قوری زیاده.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Just half a cup.
No more, thank you. That was perfect.

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: This is nice. Just you, me and a pot of tea. George and I did this for fifty years!

translations.fa: چه خوبه. فقط تو، من و یه قوری چای. من و جورج پنجاه سال این کار را می‌کردیم!
